title: How Monitoring Works: Prometheus + Grafana in 60 Seconds 📊 #shorts

lines: It's 3 AM. Your app slows down. How do engineers know, before a single user complains?
Every service exposes numbers on a metrics page: how many requests, how many errors, how long each one takes, how much memory it's using.
Prometheus visits every service every few seconds, and scrapes those numbers. That's called pulling.
It stores each number with a timestamp, building a time series: the full history of every metric.
Grafana queries that history, and turns it into live dashboards: graphs, gauges, and heat maps, updating in real time.
And alert rules watch the numbers. If errors cross five percent, the on-call engineer's phone buzzes, at 3 AM, before users notice.
Expose. Scrape. Visualize. Alert. That's monitoring.
